source: Weigelt et al. 2013 global island characterization GMMC

semantics.raw_Weigelt_gmmc_1: connected to a continental mainland during the Last Glacial Maximum
semantics.raw_Weigelt_gmmc_0: not connected to a continental mainland during the Last Glacial Maximum
semantics.claim_boundary: this is a coarse historical-connectivity / continental-shelf proxy that differentiates oceanic and continental islands well; it is not a complete geological-origin classification

model_rule.within_system_primary_model: use the already-frozen historical-isolation variable once
model_rule.cross_taxon_reporting: label the harmonized binary variable as LGM connectivity type for descriptive stratification and adjustment semantics
model_rule.secondary_type_interaction: descriptive unless separately frozen before response; may not rescue a failed overall C-minus-R3 primary
